data.one_liner: Customizable advanced drawer widget for Flutter
data.what_it_does: Provides a drawer that can be fully customized with size, color, radius, and supports gestures, RTL, and accessibility features.
use_when: Require gesture control and RTL support
avoid_when: Already using a different navigation drawer implementation
data.minimal_example:
AdvancedDrawer(
  child: Scaffold(
    appBar: AppBar(title: Text('Demo')),
    body: Center(child: Text('Home')),
  ),
  drawer: Container(color: Colors.blue, width: 250, child: Center(child: Text('Drawer'))),
  openRatio: 0.75,
  openScale: 0.85,
)
